_comment: Turret masks of the X-Piratez pirate tank, drawn by hand on the 64x80 tank canvas (the parts lie at (16,8), (32,16), (0,16), (16,24)). Polygons of pixel centres [x, y]. dome: the turret body - it turns, and the hull keeps its own dome as the turret base. barrel: the gun - it turns and is taken off the hull. mirror: a direction that is the horizontal mirror image of another one. same_as: a sheet drawn from the same model; barrel_grows_by_difference: its barrel also takes the pixels next to the barrel that differ from that sheet (a bigger muzzle).
